rationale: applyStatics.js:9 is `module.exports = function applyStatics(...)`, and lib/model.js:37 binds it via `const applyStatics = require('./helpers/model/applyStatics')`. The calls at model.js:1044 and 5068 invoke that binding, but Ariadne resolved them to the local require variable rather than following the CommonJS module.exports through to the function. No in-scope rule covers CommonJS require/module.exports resolution.
